analytic_model.boundary: j_nu and J_core do not enter intrinsic omega_c in this minimal Hamiltonian; they set the spin offset and closure spin.
analytic_model.extended_convention: If frequency is redefined from total spin, a shifted critical point can be quoted, but it is convention-dependent and is not the intrinsic shear frequency.

rpa_model.status: phenomenological response proxy; no claim of microscopic Cd/Pd fit

evidence_ledger.Roy_2011: 106Cd: bandhead 18, configuration termination 24, observed 26 effective; 108Cd: bandhead 16, AMR interval through 24; 110Cd: 12+ model bandhead, 28+ not assigned to AMR.
evidence_ledger.Rather_2014: 104Pd: Table 1 B(E2) sequence 16+--26+, fitted J_core=5 hbar^2/MeV, V_pinu=1.2 MeV.
evidence_ledger.102Pd: No verified local AMR lifetime/systematics table; retained as missing evidence.
